title: Thai Stir-Fry
description: A simple and spicy Thai stir-fry dish made with a variety of ingredients. It's a great option for a quick and easy meal.

ingredients.name: dense
ingredients.amount: 1 cup mixed vegetables (bell peppers, carrots, broccoli)

instructions: Heat oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add diced onion and cook until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
Add mixed vegetables and cook until tender, about 4-5 minutes.
Add red pepper flakes and stir to combine.
Add oats and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes, until oats are lightly toasted.
